question: Which southern direction is forbidden when Taurus, Virgo, or Capricorn prevails?
premises: Taurus, Virgo, or Capricorn may be prevailing.
Travel to the southern abode is considered.
Such travel is prohibited under these signs.
inference: One must not go to the southern direction when Taurus, Virgo, or Capricorn is present.
plain_english: When Taurus, Virgo, or Capricorn is present, one should not go to the southern direction.
